scope: RGTC capability split, CPU BC4/BC5 expansion, and residency accounting for compressed versus expanded Surface DDS uploads

implementation.native_capability: OpenGL RGTC is detected independently from S3TC; desktop GL 3+ has RGTC core support and GLES requires GL_EXT_texture_compression_rgtc
implementation.fallback: ATI1/BC4 and ATI2/BC5 expand to BGRA8 when the context lacks RGTC; BC4 writes its value to R and BC5 writes its channels to R/G
implementation.residency: The GPU budget accounts for expanded RGBA payload when native S3TC/RGTC compression is unavailable

coverage: unsupported format and truncated payload rejection
DDS structural validation and upload budget admission

host.reason: The available OpenGL device natively supports both formats; no unsupported-RGTC runtime or forced-capability readback was run.
